newsitem.title: USA: Film Roman says has reduced goals for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Film Roman says has reduced goals for 1997.

text.p: Film Roman Inc said it will report lower-than-expected results for 1996 and has reduced its goals for 1997.
The company did not provide specific figures and officials there were not immediately available to comment further.

Film Roman, which creates and produces animated television shows, said its forecasts stem from weaker-than-expected ratings for its "Bruno the Kid" series and Fox Network's decision Wednesday to drop "C-Bear & Jamal" for the 1997-1998 broadcast season. In a press statement, Film Roman also said "marketplace changes have made it increasingly difficult for independent producers to access key distribution channels for their proprietary programs."
On Wednesday, the company's stock fell nearly 50 percent -- or 2-1/4 -- to 3-1/2.
